evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Universal completion mandate frames onboarding as institutional stability (conservation) and capability-building (competence); the value language is in the universalizing 'Every' and the checklist-as-process framing.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter

observations.why: Replacement of a prior system is framed as institutional updating — the appealed-to good is keeping the process current and stable, not novelty for its own sake.
